bio.text: Larry Thompson is the Republican candidate for California's 32nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.

He was born in Clarksdale, Mississippi, served in the U.S. Army Reserve from 1968 to 1974, and earned a bachelor's degree in business administration (1966) and a J.D. (1968) from the University of Mississippi.
His professional experience includes working as a lawyer, talent manager and film producer.
